title: Refine Python Studio for mobile coding
summary: Make long code readable, expose editor controls and frame the workspace more clearly.

changes.detail: Visible line-wrap and focus-mode controls beside the file; focus mode has an exit button and Escape support. Console tab displays the actual saved run count.
Wrap long lines by default. Refine rounded workspace frame, compact header, translated subtitle, tab treatment, coding keys, editor height and status spacing.
Use a flex container and dynamic viewport height for the embedded web studio so its internal scrolling is constrained.

validation.name: Validation pending
validation.detail: Typecheck, focused lint, Python interaction regressions, rebuilt WebView bundle and responsive browser verification pending. Physical phone keyboard remains untested.
